notes: Covers the A1865 global unit. The A1901 model has an Intel XMM7480 (PMB9948) modem.

method: IFixit's teardown is of its A1865 global unit (step 1) and lists chip names and part numbers by step.
It also says Apple is dual-sourcing the modem and TechInsights found an Intel XMM7480 (PMB9948) in its A1901 model.
Apple's spec page lists models A1865 and A1901 and gives 2017 as the year introduced.
Apple's model identification table lists A1865, A1901 and A1902 (Japan) under iPhone X.

comps.spec: Apple APL1W72 A11 Bionic SoC, layered over its SK hynix RAM (step 10)
3 GB LPDDR4X RAM, SK hynix H9HKNNNDBMAUUR, under the A11 SoC (step 10); 64 GB flash memory, Toshiba TSB3234X68354TWNA1 (step 12)
Apple/Murata USI 170821 339S00397 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth module (step 11); Qualcomm MDM9655 Snapdragon X16 LTE modem (step 11)
Apple 338S00341-B1 power management IC (step 10)
Texas Instruments SN2501 battery charger (step 10)
SiTime MEMS oscillator, no part number stated (step 13)
Bosch Sensortec BMP282 pressure sensor (step 12); Bosch Sensortec gyroscope/accelerometer, no part number stated (step 12)

Lightning connector with a wider bracket that the page says looks extra-reinforced (step 19), no part number stated; NXP CBTL1612A1, which the page calls likely an iteration of the 1610 Tristar IC (step 10); Cypress CYPD2104 USB Type-C port controller (step 13)
Microphone among the upper display components, with the loudspeaker, ambient light sensor, flood illuminator and proximity sensor (step 20); no part number stated
Dual-cell battery with four pull-tabs, 10.35 Wh, 2716 mAh at 3.81 V (step 15); manufacturer not stated
12 MP wide-angle and telephoto cameras: wide-angle f/1.8 aperture, telephoto f/2.4 aperture; optical zoom; dual optical image stabilization
5.8-inch all-screen OLED multi-touch display, 2436 x 1125 pixels at 458 ppi

Earpiece speaker redesigned with a duct to channel sound out of the display (step 20); loudspeaker among the upper display components (step 20); lower speaker enclosure (step 18); no part numbers stated
Taptic Engine, described as a linear oscillator vibration motor (step 18); manufacturer and voltage not stated
7 MP TrueDepth camera, f/2.2 aperture, 1080p HD video recording
IR camera in the TrueDepth camera system, which reads the dot map projected by the IR dot projector (step 17); no part number stated
Broadcom BCM15951B0KUB2G touch screen controller (step 21)
STMicroelectronics OLED PMIC, labeled 10 THADT733 X-139U (step 21)
Apple 338S00306 power management IC (step 10)
STMicroelectronics STB600B0, listed by the page as power management (step 10)
Qualcomm PMD9655 PMIC, listed with the MDM9655 LTE modem (step 11)
Qualcomm WTR5975 gigabit LTE transceiver (step 11)
Skyworks SKY78140-22 power amplifier (step 11)
Skyworks SKY77366-17 power amplifier (step 11)
Broadcom AFEM-8072 MMMB power amplifier module (step 11)
NXP 80V18 / PN80V NFC controller module (step 11)
Broadcom BCM59355 wireless charging controller (step 11)
Apple 338S00248 audio codec (step 10)
Apple/Cirrus Logic 338S00296 audio amplifier (step 12; repeated in step 13)
